====Character====
Noland is a strategist, and timing and pinpoint accuracy are critical to his {{pkmn|battle}} technique. Even when his attacks appear to miss his opponent's Pokémon, their secondary effects have equally devastating consequences. Rather than battling with random Pokémon, Noland allows the opponent to choose who they will battle against.

Noland also enjoys inventing things and riding on the [[Air transportation in the Pokémon world|airplane]] that he built.
